name: Precision Suite
description: Tests how well an AI can identify causal validity and problem clarity.

tasks.billText: Section 101. Previous traffic investigations have found that traffic congestion in the central business district has increased during weekday commuting hours. Beginning January 1, 2028, no red passenger vehicle may be operated within the central business district between 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. on weekdays.
tasks.rationale: Banning red cars does not plausibly target the stated congestion problem.

tasks.billText: Section 201. A study (2012 Obesity Study) by the Obesity Institute has found childhood obesity rates remain elevated among school-age residents. Beginning with the 2028-2029 school year, each public school shall require all enrolled students to wear a standard uniform approved by the Department of Education.
tasks.rationale: School uniforms do not provide a credible causal mechanism for reducing childhood obesity.

tasks.billText: Section 301. If a public school or licensed child care facility records drinking water lead levels above the federal action level in two consecutive testing periods, the responsible water utility shall replace the lead service line serving that facility within 24 months. The Department of Health shall administer grants for replacement costs and shall require follow-up testing after completion.
tasks.rationale: The intervention directly addresses the identified lead exposure problem with targeted remediation and follow-up verification.

tasks.billText: Section 401. Legislative findings state that the state continues to face a shortage of nurses willing to practice in remote counties where vacancy rates are highest. In order to address that shortage, a sales-tax holiday for school supplies shall be held during the first weekend of August each year.
tasks.rationale: The chosen tax holiday does not plausibly affect the identified workforce recruitment bottleneck in remote health care settings.

tasks.billText: Section 402. Legislative findings report that missed court appearances in misdemeanor cases are driven in part by defendants not receiving timely reminders or not having transportation arranged. Each trial court shall, at the time of release, collect a preferred phone number or mailing address for reminder notices, send reminders seven days and 24 hours before each hearing, and offer transit vouchers for indigent defendants when lack of transportation is documented.
tasks.rationale: The policy targets two concrete causes of missed appearances, notice failure and transportation barriers, using mechanisms tied to the diagnosed problem.
